Overview

Baton Rouge is a city in LA with a population of 222,185. Red Stick with LSU Tigers, Cajun food, Mississippi River, and Southern affordability. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 31.8.
